tags.gist: Appreciates FDA's engagement with stakeholders and wants the framework to support safe, well-governed innovation.
Holds that clinical AI should augment physicians within clinical boundaries, with safety, accountability, auditability and human oversight remaining essential as systems grow.
Sees closing the gap between fast technology and slower regulation as shared work, including agreeing consistent terms for clinical functions, autonomy, oversight and risk.
Wants a clear, consistent description of where AI that supports a clinician's plan ends and AI exercising independent clinical judgment begins, mapped to existing frameworks.
Asks FDA to keep clarifying how GenAI risks map to controls and evidence, proportional to risk and crediting design controls, human factors and oversight.
Says industry and regulators share the goal of getting beneficial technology to patients efficiently with appropriate safety standards.
